name: UserWay tool
project_description:
The UserWay Integration module provides seamless integration of the UserWay accessibility tool with your Drupal site. This module allows site administrators to easily configure and manage the UserWay widget, ensuring enhanced accessibility for all users.

 Features 
 
 Configuration Page:
 
 Provides an intuitive admin interface to input and manage the UserWay key. 
 
 
 Custom Block:
 
 Adds a configurable block to render the UserWay accessibility tool on your site. 
 Easy placement of the UserWay widget on various parts of your site using Drupal's block layout system. 
 
 
 Permission Control:
 
 Administers specific permissions to manage who can configure the UserWay settings. 
 Ensures only authorized users can access and modify the UserWay configuration. 
 
 
 Seamless Integration:
 
 Automatically includes the UserWay script on your site once the key is configured. 
 
 
 Warning Messages:
 
 Displays a warning message if the UserWay key is not configured, ensuring administrators are aware of the missing configuration. 
 
 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, developers can navigate to "/admin/config/services/userway" to fill in the key. Ensure that the "administer userway" permission is granted for access control, and the "view userway widget" permission is granted to view the UserWay widget. You can then add the UserWay widget block to any desired location on your site.
